title: VersionNegotiationResponse
description: Forward-compatible selected sessionwire version. hostlink_methods is the optional set of reserved HostLink method names the replying Host serves; it is absent when the Host advertises nothing and its item values are deliberately open so a method added later does not invalidate an older consumer.

items.description: A reserved HostLink method name such as hostlink.attach; Core enforces the 256-byte identifier limit and tolerates a name it does not know.
